title: Finance Analyst
jobDescription:
The Finance Transformation & Process Architect is a strategic hybrid role designed for a professional who 'connects the dots' between complex financial operations and cutting-edge technology. You will be responsible for re-engineering core finance processes—specifically in Budgeting, Forecasting, and Budgetary Control—and translating those needs into a robust digital architecture. You are not just a functional expert or a developer; you are the bridge that ensures technology serves financial accuracy and operational efficiency. Key Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Project Orchestration: Lead cross-functional sprints between Finance and IT/GDIA to ensure digital tools are delivered on time and meet functional requirements. Process Architecture & Value Stream Mapping: Lead the end-to-end mapping of finance workstreams (Planning, Forecasting, Month-end Close, and Budget Control). Utilize Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and process flow charting to identify bottlenecks and 'friction points,' designing future state architectures that eliminate manual intervention. The Strategic Bridge: Act as the primary translator between Finance stakeholders and IT/Data Engineering teams. Connect the dots between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that automated solutions solve real-world financial pain points. Systems & Data Integration: Optimize and integrate finance workflows within SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Essbase environments. Ensure that data flows seamlessly between ERP systems, process workflows, and reporting layers. Solution Design & Automation: Develop and prototype efficiency tools like Data Form, the MS Power Platform (Power Automate/Apps), or Visualization tools (e.g. Power BI). Identify the 'right tool for the job' to improve process velocity and data integrity. Agentic AI & Innovation: Identify use cases for Agentic AI and LLMs to handle cognitive finance tasks, such as automated variance analysis, complex reconciliations, and predictive forecasting. Data Strategy & Lineage: Oversee the migration of finance data into Data Lakes/EDP. Ensure a 'single source of truth' by maintaining strict data lineage and integrity across all automated reporting outputs. Digital Capability & Citizen Development: Serve as a Lead Citizen Developer and 'AI Evangelist' for the Finance team. Design and deliver hands-on training sessions to upskill colleagues on 'last-mile' technologies, including Generative AI/LLM prompt engineering, Power Platform (Power Automate/Apps), and data visualization. Your goal is to foster a culture of technical curiosity and empower the broader finance organization to build their own automated micro-solutions. Desired Technical Skills & Experience: Core Finance Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of FP&A cycles, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Budgetary Control. Must understand the accounting logic behind complex accruals and financial modeling. Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Essbase. Data Transformation & Analytics: Expert level in tools like Alteryx for ETL and data blending. Professional-grade skills in Power BI or similar tools. Automation & Low-Code: Advanced proficiency in the MS Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps). Technical Literacy: Ability to write and understand SQL for data extraction, Python for advanced modeling, and a basic understanding of APIs for system integration. Methodology: Proven experience in Lean Six Sigma tools, specifically VSM and bottleneck analysis. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of financial acumen and technical literacy. We are looking for 5+ years of total professional experience, demonstrated through one of the following pathways: 1: Finance-First Professional

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics, paired with a Master’s or certification in Business Analytics/Data Science. OR a Qualified CA, CMA, or MBA (Finance) with certifications in digital tools (e.g., MS Power Platform, Alteryx, or Power Query). Experience: 5+ years in Finance, with at least 3+ years specifically dedicated to Finance Transformation, Systems Implementation, or Process Re-engineering. 2: Technical-First Professional

EDUCATION:
B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related technical field. Experience: 5+ years of total professional experience, including 2–3 years of proven functional experience working directly within Finance operations or processes (e.g., Forecasting, Budgeting, or Financial Reporting). Demonstrated Success: A portfolio of completed projects where you successfully bridged the gap between a manual finance process and a fully automated, scalable digital solution.

title: Process Engineer – Engine Assembly
jobDescription: Ford Powertrain Manufacturing Engineers contribute to the design and production of advanced engines and propulsion systems. This role is responsible for developing and implementing assembly systems that support efficient, safe, and high-quality engine manufacturing operations. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and suppliers to ensure robust assembly processes, efficient material flow, and successful program launches. The position requires a strong understanding of assembly engineering principles, manufacturing systems, process optimisation, and continuous improvement methodologies. Process Design & Development Develop and optimise engine assembly process flows, line layouts, and workstation designs. Design assembly stations with a strong focus on ergonomics and safety. Prepare process sheets, work instructions, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Support new model launches, engineering changes, and assembly process modifications. Evaluate assembly feasibility and incorporate Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles. Conduct time studies, motion studies, and line balancing activities. Equipment & Tooling Specify, design, and validate assembly equipment, fixtures, tooling, and automation systems. Coordinate equipment design reviews, installation, commissioning, and buyoff activities with suppliers. Ensure equipment meets safety, quality, productivity, and ergonomic standards. Support assembly equipment troubleshooting and process optimisation. Quality & Continuous Improvement Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for manufacturing and quality issues. Support Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Control Plans, and error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) implementation. Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and Six Sigma improvement projects. Improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimise manufacturing cycle times. Capacity Planning & Material Flow Support capital planning and cost estimation for assembly projects. Perform capacity analysis, line balancing, and takt time calculations. Evaluate material handling and feeding systems to improve assembly line efficiency. Implement Lean material flow principles within manufacturing layouts. Safety & Compliance Ensure manufacturing processes comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations. Conduct manufacturing risk assessments and implement safety improvements. Support compliance with Ford and industry manufacturing standards. Supplier & Documentation Support Support procurement activities related to manufacturing equipment and tooling. Participate in supplier evaluations and technical reviews. Manage OEM documentation, including installation manuals, spare parts lists, preventive maintenance plans, and engineering drawing packages. Ensure documentation is complete before project closure. Education Bachelor’s Degree in: Mechanical Engineering Manufacturing Engineering Production Engineering Industrial Engineering Automotive Engineering Electrical Engineering Experience 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or assembly engineering. Experience in automotive, powertrain, or high-volume manufacturing environments preferred. Experience supporting new product launches and assembly process implementation.
